# snipeit_hardware (Resource)

Manages an asset (hardware) in Snipe-IT.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "snipeit_category" "laptops" {
  name          = "Laptops"
  category_type = "asset"
}

resource "snipeit_manufacturer" "apple" {
  name = "Apple"
}

resource "snipeit_model" "mbp14" {
  name            = "MacBook Pro 14\""
  model_number    = "A2779"
  category_id     = snipeit_category.laptops.id
  manufacturer_id = snipeit_manufacturer.apple.id
  eol             = 48
}

resource "snipeit_status_label" "ready" {
  name = "Ready to Deploy"
  type = "deployable"
}

resource "snipeit_hardware" "mbp" {
  asset_tag     = "IT-0001"
  model_id      = snipeit_model.mbp14.id
  status_id     = snipeit_status_label.ready.id
  serial        = "C02XXXXXXX"
  purchase_date = "2026-01-15"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asset_tag` (String) Unique asset tag.
- `model_id` (Number) Id of the asset model.
- `status_id` (Number) Id of the status label.

### Optional

- `company_id` (Number) Id of the company owning this asset.
- `location_id` (Number) Id of the default (ready-to-deploy) location of this asset.
- `name` (String) Display name of the asset.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `order_number` (String) Order number of the purchase.
- `purchase_cost` (String) Purchase cost as a decimal string, e.g. `1234.50`. Stored normalized; `1234.5`, `1234.50` and `1,234.50` are the same value.
- `purchase_date` (String) Purchase date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.
- `requestable` (Boolean) Whether this asset can be requested by users.
- `serial` (String) Serial number of the asset.
- `supplier_id` (Number) Id of the supplier of this asset.
- `warranty_months` (Number) Warranty duration in months.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the asset.
